title: Lear takes UFO claims to KLAS; Knapp checks the files
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Lear takes UFO claims to KLAS; Knapp checks the files, about late 1980s at Las Vegas, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um and then he walks in with this UFO madness.

plain: A filmmaker, Jeremy Corbell, says that in the late 1980s a pilot named John Lear walked into KLAS, a Las Vegas TV station, with what Corbell calls "UFO madness", wild claims about alien craft. According to Corbell, a reporter there, George Knapp, checked the files on Lear, with a man named Ned Day also part of the story. It is told as the start of Knapp taking UFO claims seriously, which would matter if the claims held up.
